book: A volume of three works: Iacobus Gaillardus's Specimen quaestionum in Novum Instrumentum de filio hominis (1684), with title pages, dedication, epistle and index, then twenty questions each followed by a Usus; Richardi Simonis Opuscula critica (1685), with epistle, Castigationes and Excerpta; and Hieronymi Le Camus's Judicium (1685), with epistle and an Italian satirical piece.
